name: miami-real-estate-ml
description: Miami-Dade & Broward home price predictor: LightGBM with geospatial features, SHAP explanations, and a Streamlit dashboard.

paragraphs: An interactive dashboard of 1,000 recent home sales in Miami-Dade and Broward counties: price by ZIP code, by property type, and against size. It describes past sales; it does not predict prices (see why).
Live Demo: miami-real-estate-ml.onrender.com (free tier, so the first load may take a moment to wake up)
An earlier version of this project predicted prices with LightGBM and SHAP. It was removed on purpose:
features: The first score was wrong. It reported R² 0.99, but two features were computed from the sale price itself and ZIP price statistics included the test rows (target leakage). After removing them, the honest score was R² ≈…

0.82 is not precise. The typical error was about 28%, and the 80% error band ran from roughly −29% to +63% of the estimate. Most of the signal came from square footage and property type; the model also overfit (train R²…

Location was the weak part. With ZIP-level coordinates and 7 sales per ZIP, the same house's estimate moved by about 10% (up to 30% in the worst tenth of cases) depending on which neighboring ZIP it was matched to.…
